audience: Research requester, returning investigator and package maintainer
top_tasks: Open and browse the right investigation; see its exact question.
Distinguish a recorded citation from a source-supported claim.
Read a complete self-contained answer and follow its evidence.
Recover stale review, rejected save and malformed records without losing work.
Install, verify and return using the complete product.
authority: User-authorized exhaustive estate repair; parent owns edition and central delivery.
truth_boundary: Current content-bound declared review; no automated semantic entailment, source authenticity, reviewer identity authentication, universal accessibility or model trial. The optional loopback service is real and browser-tested locally.
